name: silarhi/picasso-bundle
description: Responsive images for Symfony: one Twig component for AVIF/WebP srcset, blur placeholders, Glide/Imgix, inspired by next/image

suggest.imagine/imagine: Required for the BlurHash placeholder (supports GD and Imagick)
suggest.intervention/image-driver-vips: Required for the Glide vips driver (league/glide 3 or later, needs libvips and the FFI extension)
suggest.league/glide: Required for the Glide transformer (local image transformation)
suggest.psr/cache: Caches the guessed image metadata and the BlurHash strings (any PSR-6 pool, e.g. symfony/cache)
suggest.psr/http-client: Required for the URL loader (PSR-18 HTTP client interface)
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required for the URL loader (PSR-17 HTTP factory interface)
suggest.symfony/console: Required for the picasso:warmup and picasso:purge commands
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Register Silarhi\PicassoBundle\PicassoBundle for the configuration, the services and the image route (optional: without it, build the loaders, transformers and ImageHelper by hand, without symfony/dependency-injection nor symfony/config)
suggest.symfony/http-client: Provides a PSR-18 HTTP client implementation for the URL loader
suggest.symfony/lock: Required for the Glide lock option (render each missing variant once)
suggest.symfony/stopwatch: Times the renders, the placeholders and the served images in the web profiler
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: Required for the picasso_image() and picasso_image_url() Twig functions
suggest.symfony/web-link: Required to preload priority images (Link header)
suggest.twig/twig: Required for PicassoExtension (the picasso_image() and picasso_image_url() Twig functions) without TwigBundle

scripts.bump:tools: @composer bump ergebnis/composer-normalize friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer phpstan/* phpunit/phpunit rector/rector vincentlanglet/twig-cs-fixer
